messages:
Erin: Heads-up — planning API/SDK v7 deploy tomorrow 15:00 UTC. No DB migrations. Goal: cut traffic, run smoke, full rollout by 16:30 if green. Owners below; ping if you can't take the slot.
Sam: Can you confirm backward compatibility for v6 clients? any required headers or error changes?
Jia: v7 adds optional `client_feature` header and a new `warnings` field in batch responses. Neither should break v6 clients — we keep old shapes.
Maya: Changelog drafted: https://wiki.redwood/v7-changelog (will email customers in the 2pm window). Planning: blog + small migration note for integrators.
Leo: I'll own smoke and basic perf checks. Plan: canary 10% for 15 minutes, run these tests: `curl -sS /health`, run sample load script, verify latency p95 < 200ms.
Alex: Rollback plan: revert deploy tag + route traffic back to v6 instances. Quick commands:
```
# switch traffic
kubectl label svc inference route=v6 --overwrite
# revert deploy
git checkout tags/v6-stable && deploy/scripts/ci-deploy.sh
```
ops-bot: CI build passed (v7) — 14:20 UTC. All integration tests green.
dev-bot: Canary job scheduled at 15:00 UTC for 10% traffic for 15m.
Sam: For deprecation we should add `Deprecation` response header with date? ops ok with adding header as non-breaking?
Jia: Yeah we can add `Deprecation: 2026-09-01` as a hint; won't affect parsing.
Maya: I'll draft the customer email after final sign-off. Suggest flash note in Console > Releases at rollout.
Leo: Smoke checklist (I will post results inline):
- basic api calls (auth + chat + embeddings)
- long-sequence kv cache sanity
- streaming chunk ordering
- cost-per-token sanity check
(should take ~12min)
Erin: @Leo thanks. Can you confirm you have access to the rollback runbook?
Leo: Confirmed — have steps and access. I'll tag @Alex if we need a forced revert.
Alex: If rollback happens, I will coordinate traffic and post timeline.
Sam: Quick question: will feature-flag gating be available for the `client_feature`? Canary to 10% only has routing; feature-flag lets us toggle at subset users.
Jia: Not in this deploy — feature-flagging is on the roadmap, but we can gate via header routing for now.
Erin: Okay final checklist for tomorrow:
- 14:00 UTC: Maya finalizes client comms
- 14:30 UTC: Ops staging smoke sign-off (manual)
- 15:00 UTC: Start canary (10% for 15m) — Leo watches smoke
- 15:20 UTC: Decision point (rollback or proceed)
- 15:30-16:30 UTC: Gradual increase to 100% if green
Please react with :thumbsup: if you can take your listed task.
Maya: :thumbsup: I'll send the email at 14:05 and post Console note at 14:10.
Sam: :thumbsup: I'll review compat tests 14:40 and be on-call for breakages.
Leo: :thumbsup: I'll run the smoke script and post results in this thread.
Alex: :thumbsup: I'll stand by for rollback ops.
Erin: Thanks team — I'll post a final reminder 30m before deploy. If anything blocks before 14:45 UTC, raise here.
